newsitem.title: UK: UK meal/feeds lacks buying interest, firmer stance.
newsitem.headline: UK meal/feeds lacks buying interest, firmer stance.

text.p: UK meals and feeds lacked buying interest due to the continued high selling levels still being experienced, with little hope seen at present of much change.

Traders said they were looking for lower UK prices to emerge from Chicago's soybean meal futures following a sharp losses at the U.S. start, but this was really only a turnaround from gains seen at Tuesday's Chicago close.
At the close UK soybean meal selling levels stood one sterling per tonne firmer, while rapemeal was again completely unchanged.
